# Design system

<!-- mirage:section tokens -->
## Tokens

Spacing and radius tokens follow an 8-point grid (Q-007).

<!-- mirage:section typography -->
## Typography

The platform system font at three sizes.

<!-- mirage:section color -->
## Color

The shop's green on white, with a dark theme.

<!-- mirage:section components -->
## Components

Platform-native components; no third-party library.

<!-- mirage:section motion -->
## Motion

Standard platform transitions; reduced motion is respected.

<!-- mirage:section imagery -->
## Icons and imagery

Platform icon sets; no photography in v1.0.
